Manipal Health repays ₹5,310 crore debt with IPO funds

Manipal Health Enterprises has repaid a debt of ₹5,310 crore using proceeds from its Initial Public Offering (IPO). This repayment is intended to reduce the company's interest burden, improve its leverage, and enhance financial flexibility for future expansion and investments. The debt redemption was executed as per the company's July 31, 2026, Prospectus.
